title: Transbank — DP-6008 'transaction may not have been refunded' (HTTP 422) on partial refund, no fix on our side
symptom: Partial Refund por monto menor (incluye Mall Transaction). Refund V2 failed with DP-6008 'transaction may not have been refunded' (HTTP 422). Transbank partial refund is being rejected by the PSP/back-end, so the refund cannot be completed. Fails validating that the transaction is partially refunded. Recurring Transbank-side partial refund rejection across the refund suite with the same signature.
recipe: NOT a fix — this is a known, recurring Transbank-side (PSP/back-end) rejection confirmed external to DEUNA: Transbank returns HTTP 422 DP-6008 'transaction may not have been refunded' on the partial refund (Refund V2) step, for both standard and Mall transactions, so the transaction never reaches the partially-refunded state. No code change on our side resolves it — do NOT swap cards via cardFixer (the KB prior art suggested cardFixer, but this is not a card problem), do not relax the refund assertion, do not escalate to serviceInvestigator. Mark the regression row as reviewed via the known-issue disposition (QA Review=OK, Root cause QA=External issue) so devs don't re-triage a case that's already understood. If Transbank starts accepting these partial refunds and this stops recurring, this entry will simply stop matching (no manual deprecation needed) — re-open only if Transbank confirms a permanent fix and you want to retire the entry explicitly.
